NewsHub Documentation¶

Welcome to the documentation for NewsHub, a Django-based news application.

Overview¶

NewsHub is a Django web application that provides a platform for managing and reading news articles.

The application supports four user roles:

  • Reader

  • Editor

  • Journalist

  • Publisher

Main Features¶

User Management¶

Users can register and log into the NewsHub application. User roles determine which features and dashboards are available to them.

Articles¶

Journalists can create and manage news articles. Articles can be reviewed and approved before publication.

Newsletters¶

The application provides newsletter functionality for users who subscribe to news content.

Publishers¶

Publishers can be created and managed through the application and can be associated with articles.

Subscriptions¶

Readers can subscribe to journalists and access subscribed content through the subscriptions functionality.

REST API¶

NewsHub includes REST API functionality using Django REST Framework.

The API provides functionality related to articles and approved articles, with permissions controlling access to write operations.

Database¶

NewsHub uses MariaDB/MySQL as its database.

The database connection is configured through environment variables rather than storing database passwords directly in the source code.

Docker¶

The project includes Docker support using:

  • Dockerfile

  • compose.yaml

  • MariaDB

The Docker Compose configuration starts both the Django web application and the MariaDB database.

Database migrations are automatically executed when the web container starts.

Testing¶

The Django test suite can be run using:

docker compose exec web python manage.py test news

Application Checks¶

Django’s system checks can be run using:

docker compose exec web python manage.py check

Building the Documentation¶

From the project root, install Sphinx if necessary:

python -m pip install sphinx

Then generate the HTML documentation:

python -m sphinx -b html docs docs/_build/html

The generated documentation is available in:

docs/_build/html/

Open docs/_build/html/index.html in a web browser to view the documentation.
